notes.title: Mannequin Mayhem - Physics Ragdoll Shooter
notes.content:
What's Up, Gamers? Ready for a Wild Ride?

Welcome to "Mannequin Mayhem," the craziest shooter you'll play this year! Forget zombies and aliens – it's time to blast some seriously creepy mannequins. They're stiff, they're awkward, and they're out to get you. Why? Who cares! Just grab your gun and show these dummies who's boss!
The Deal:
• Ragdoll Madness: These aren’t your average enemies. With funky ragdoll physics, every shot sends these mannequins flying in hilarious ways. It's like a physics experiment gone wild!
• Survive the Waves: Brace yourself for endless waves of mannequin madness. How long can you last against these relentless dummies?
• Cool Guns, Cooler Shots: Load up with a variety of guns. Customize your arsenal and discover creative ways to take down wave after wave of these weirdos.

"Mannequin Mayhem" is all about having a blast (literally) and getting a good laugh while you're at it. So, ready to take on the weirdest enemies ever? Let's do this!
